Hizmet ve Süreç Özeti

  • Gümrük beyannamelerinin profesyonelce doldurulması
  • HMRC (İngiliz Gümrük) ile koordinasyon
  • Pasaport kopyası ve vize durumu

Service and Process Overview

  • Professional completion of customs declarations
  • Coordination with HMRC (UK Customs)
  • Passport copy and visa status
  • ToR1 application number
  • Detailed packing list (Inventory)
  • Address info or accommodation declaration in the UK
  • Expert Team: Full mastery of UK customs legislation post-Brexit.
  • Secure Packing: Packaging at international shipping standards.
